about: Pose forms for Ani's mannequin, chosen by eye from CMU motion capture contact sheets (tools/poses/sheet_clips.py, 2026-11-20). Descriptions name the pose only: props come from the person's words (contract: only what she asked for). tools/poses/build_forms.py turns this list into homeai/poses/library/.
credit: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu.

forms.name: Sword guard
forms.description: a figure in a fighting stance, both hands together in front at chest height, knees bent

forms.name: Sword raised overhead
forms.description: a figure with both hands raised above the head, about to strike downward

forms.name: Sword thrust
forms.description: a figure reaching forward with both arms, as if thrusting

forms.name: Low swing
forms.description: a figure crouched low, swinging both arms forward and down

forms.name: Boxing guard
forms.description: a figure with both fists raised in front of the face

forms.name: Lunging punch
forms.description: a figure lunging forward with one arm punching straight ahead, back leg stretched out

forms.name: Long jab
forms.description: a figure in a deep lunge, one arm stretched far forward

forms.name: Front kick
forms.description: a figure standing on one leg, kicking the other leg straight forward

forms.name: Kneeling on one knee
forms.description: a figure kneeling on one knee, leaning forward

forms.name: Crouching
forms.description: a figure crouched low on bent knees, leaning forward

forms.name: Sitting
forms.description: a figure sitting upright, knees bent, hands resting

forms.name: Running
forms.description: a figure running, one leg pushing off behind, arms swinging

forms.name: Running stride
forms.description: a figure mid-stride while running, front knee bent, back leg stretched

forms.name: Waving one arm high
forms.description: a figure waving one arm high above the head, the other arm out to the side

forms.name: Both arms up
forms.description: a figure with both arms raised up

forms.name: Pointing to the side
forms.description: a figure pointing with one arm stretched out to the side

forms.name: Standing
forms.description: a figure standing relaxed, arms loosely at the sides

forms.name: Palm pushed out
forms.description: a figure in a wide stance pushing one open hand forward

forms.name: Wide stance, arms out
forms.description: a figure in a wide low stance with both arms spread

gaps: No bows, shields or riding in the chosen clips: archer, shield block and riding forms are to be set by hand.
